note: Straight-alpha RGBA layers, far to near. Each PNG includes the overscan margin; place its top-left at `offset` in painting coordinates. depth: suggested parallax factor (0 = sky ... 1 = nearest). flat.png = all layers composited with normal blending.

layers.name: sky
layers.note: the sun glowing through the mist (in frame); opaque

layers.name: far
layers.note: far trunks dissolving in the glowing mist

layers.name: mid

layers.name: beams
layers.note: rays from the sun fanning toward the camera + bloom (robot goes above this)

layers.name: fg
layers.note: dark backlit ferns/grass at the bottom, a near trunk at the right edge
